The '''Anorelgan slip-socker''' was a device from the [[Anorelga system/Legends|Anorelga system]].

==Behind the scenes==
Reference to the Anorelgan slip-socker was removed when [[Riders of the Maelstrom (adventure)|''Riders of the Maelstrom'']] was reprinted in ''[[Classic Adventures: Volume Three]]''.
